title: YOLO Vision API
description: RESTful API for real-time object detection using YOLOv8. Supports multiple model sizes, custom trained models, and batch processing with async queue.

title: Microservices Platform
description: Scalable e-commerce backend built with microservices architecture. Features include service discovery, distributed tracing, and auto-scaling with Kubernetes.

title: Data Pipeline ETL
description: High-throughput ETL pipeline processing 1M+ records daily. Features include data validation, transformation, and loading to data warehouse with monitoring.

title: Real-time Chat System
description: WebSocket-based chat application with end-to-end encryption. Supports group chats, file sharing, and message persistence with read receipts.

title: DevOps Automation Toolkit
description: Collection of Terraform modules and GitHub Actions workflows for automating infrastructure provisioning, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring setup.

title: Data Annotation Tool
description: Web-based tool for image annotation supporting bounding boxes, segmentation, and classification. Export formats include COCO, YOLO, and Pascal VOC.
